author: Arnav
problem: Read N and M marks a_1 < ... < a_M. The numbers 1 to N are written in order, with a mark between a_i and a_i + 1. Each maximal group of numbers joined by marks is read in reverse; the groups are read left to right. Print the order in which 1 to N are read.
bug_description: Sorts each group's numbers as strings, so with numbers 10 and above '9' comes before '10' in reverse order.

comments.accurate: Groups numbers joined by marks and prints each group from largest to smallest
comments.wrong_behavior: Groups numbers joined by marks and prints each group's labels in reverse text order
comments.wrong_location: Group sorting verified; check the separator added after the last number N

source.fixed_line: result += sorted(list(map(int, subgraph.split("v"))), reverse=True) if len(subgraph) > 0 else []
